Shipped v29.03 (`cw-feedall`). The map story card, the cooked-grenade shout, ACTIVE RELOAD and a CLOSE CALL label with no score now also go into the player feed. Preflight passed, the gate passed, and the seed 4242 fingerprint held at 85/374 and 165/593.

`say()` and the world labels already fed almost everything, so only these four texts were missing:
- **Story card:** the name is one feed line and the text is a line under it. The code had said it "never goes into the feed"; that is reversed now.
- **Cooked grenade shout:** COOKED GRENADE! THROW GRENADE NOW is a danger line in the feed.
- **ACTIVE RELOAD and bare CLOSE CALL:** these were skipped by the feed filter and now pass it.

I left three on-screen texts out of the feed on purpose:
- **WEAK SPOT:** it is a hit mark, and an old check (28790) relies on it being skipped.
- **PICKED UP:** it already has a pickup row.
- **NOTORIETY +n:** it already has its own NOTORIETY line.

The menu toasts (`hubToast`) stay menu-only, since the feed only exists inside a raid.

I marked the item DONE in `notes\evening.md`. Next open items are the wheel in the Undercroft with the cursor shown over it, the rocket launcher slot, and the craft hold bar plus craft x10.
